changelog: ✨ Streamlined Clean Phone UI: Instant access to content rows
🔥 Direct HLS Stream Engine: Restored high-speed multi-audio Hindi/English/South streams for all movies & series
⚡ Fixed OTA Update: Direct zero-redirect updater
🎥 ExoPlayer / AndroidX Media3 Engine: video now decodes onto a real hardware SurfaceView, permanently fixing the black-screen-with-audio bug on Fire TV OS and legacy Android TV panels
⚡ Auto Native Handoff: Fire TV devices route Live TV and movies straight to the hardware player — no 3-second black screen wait
🔧 Software Decoder Fallback: if a Fire TV hardware codec refuses the stream, playback automatically re-initialises on software H.264/AAC
🔒 Legacy SSL Trust: OkHttp data source with permissive trust manager so HTTPS IPTV CDNs load on 2014-2016 panels with expired root CAs
📡 Permissive HLS Parsing: non-IDR keyframes and access-unit detection enabled for tokenized IPTV .m3u8 playlists
🎮 Clean Back Exit: player releases the decoder before finishing, returning D-Pad focus to the TV UI instantly
